website.note: Pipeline confirmed via 10-K Item 1 Overview / clinical program summaries; corporate site (kodiak.com) mirrors the 10-K disclosures.

pipeline.modality: Anti-VEGF antibody biopolymer conjugate (ABC platform); enhanced 50 mg/mL formulation with conjugated and unconjugated antibody

indications.indication: Wet age-related macular degeneration (wAMD) — treatment-naive (registration-supporting Phase 3)
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 non-inferiority study with parallel investigational arms of tarcocimab and KSI-501 vs aflibercept; tarcocimab arm dosed every 4-24 weeks following 4 monthly loading doses, treat-to-dryness AI-driven assessment
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (enrollment completed; topline 1-year primary endpoint readout expected 3Q 2026)
key_milestones: BLA filing planned for tarcocimab in DR, RVO, and wAMD

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-masked, sham-controlled Phase 3 in DR patients
key_milestones: Following positive GLOW1 and GLOW2 Phase 3 readouts in DR (primary endpoints met)

pipeline.modality: Bispecific anti-IL-6 / VEGF-trap fusion on the ABC platform; enhanced 50 mg/mL formulation

indications.trial_design: Phase 3 non-inferiority arm vs aflibercept; KSI-501 dosed every 8 weeks fixed plus individualized PRN after 4 monthly loading doses
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (enrollment completed; topline 1-year primary endpoint readout 3Q 2026)

pipeline.modality: High-strength (100 mg/mL) bispecific protein targeting IL-6 and VEGF (intravitreal injection)

indications.indication: Macular edema secondary to inflammation (MESI) — moderate-to-severe disease
indications.trial_design: Superiority Phase 3 evaluating KSI-101 5 mg and 10 mg vs sham in MESI patients with moderate-to-severe macular edema; 6 monthly fixed loading doses then individualized PRN
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (initiated 2025-07-30; primary endpoint at Week 24; topline data expected 4Q 2026)

indications.indication: Macular edema secondary to inflammation (MESI) — milder disease / good vision
indications.trial_design: Superiority Phase 3 with identical design to PEAK but milder MESI / good-vision patients; KSI-101 5 mg and 10 mg vs sham
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (initiated 2025-07-16; primary endpoint at Week 24; topline data expected 2Q 2027)

summary_counts.note: Counts by distinct asset (highest active phase across indications). tarcocimab = Phase 3 (DAYBREAK in wAMD active-not-recruiting + DR confirmatory). tabirafusp/KSI-501 = Phase 3 (DAYBREAK in wAMD). KSI-101 = Phase 3 (PEAK and PINNACLE in MESI, both recruiting). Five Phase 3 trials currently active across the three assets. BLA filing planned for tarcocimab in DR/RVO/wAMD pending DAYBREAK readout. Multiple prior Phase 3 studies (GLOW1, GLOW2, BEACON, DAYLIGHT) successfully met primary endpoints.
